title: Progressive gate and fleet recovery reads
description: Uses source UI, a real authenticated private gateway, held transport replies and an isolated Git workspace. Never releases a slot or starts a worker. Requires an existing isolated Agent Chrome CDP endpoint. Cost controls require an unmodified prior source archive with the same dependencies and a published ancestry input. Their isolated fleet measurement does not claim full production-fleet acceptance.

proofTargets.claim: Stored acceptance and paused action controls render within two seconds while the current read is held.
The stored Package opens without eager source reads; pending source reads restart when the captured package changes.
Withholding the stored response prevents package details from appearing until it is released.
The actual fleet dialog shows its saved eligible row before current inspection completes, with release paused.
The prior source repeats full workspace probes and published SHA compares during the same mounted one-minute client read window.
Unchanged workspace reads launch no full probe during the warm minute; the real published SHA pair is compared once and each fleet.status finishes under ten seconds.

A 31-slot cold status answers within two seconds without Retry; background checks produce all 30 enabled observations within fifteen seconds with at most four concurrent fingerprints, retaining sub-two-second warm reads.
A mounted release dialog receives a real staged Git change immediately after monitor-owned background observation, reducing bulk eligibility without reopening.
